checks.label: Frontmatter parses and declares a name and a description
Name uses lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 64 characters or fewer
Name matches the skill's folder name
Description says when an agent should use the skill
SKILL.md body is 500 lines or fewer
A license is declared in the frontmatter or the repository
Repository has a commit in the last 12 months

skills.name: geekflare
skills.description: Use Geekflare for live web search (including full Google SERP results), scraping public webpages into Markdown or structured JSON, page metadata, brand identity (logos, colors, fonts), screenshots, URL-to-PDF, and website diagnostics such as uptime, DNS, DNSSEC, TLS/SSL, redirects, broken links, load time, and Lighthouse audits. Trigger when a user needs current public-web data, clean page content, a visual capture, or a health check of a website or domain, even if they do not mention Geekflare.
skills.summary: Search the live web, extract public page data, capture screenshots and PDFs, and check website health through Geekflare MCP or its REST API.
